profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bloomberg | Python & Distributed Systems | Agentic AI for Financial Data | Ex-Bank of America Development Lead | 22 Years in FinTech, Risk & Trading Platforms
profile.summary:
I build the systems that turn messy financial data into something people can trust, and I've been doing it for about 22 years.

Most recently, I co-led the move of a loan-data pipeline from rules to agents. Early results cut time-to-market from 25+ days to just over 4. The agentic design combines a Claude Code orchestrator, specialized LLM sub-agents, and deterministic Python. It reached 99.4% entity-match and 98.0% field accuracy against ground truth and brought 40 previously manual filers within reach of automation. It ran side by side with the legacy pipeline, with human review, so production was never put at risk.

Before that, at Bloomberg, I took a Python/Celery data acquisition gateway that acquires more than 120 billion datapoints a day from 1 to 6 client tenants by designing and rolling out multi-tenancy. I also optimized its database usage 30x, after which it went nearly a year without a database-related production incident. Earlier, I helped found a developer-experience team and modernized an 8+ year-old Python test framework with Docker and Jenkins nightly regression pipelines.

I spent 11 years at Bank of America in New York and Singapore as a Development Lead. There I architected a distributed Python risk engine for Equity Derivatives and the full-revaluation stack behind quarterly CCAR stress testing. I led a 10–15 engineer global team, increased release rollout velocity by 400%, and cut production bugs by 80%. I started out in QA and test automation at Persistent Systems, IBM, Merrill Lynch, and JPMorgan, and that discipline still shapes how I build.

What I bring:
• Distributed systems and backend design in Python (Kafka, Celery, Docker, CI/CD)
• Production agentic AI: orchestration, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls
• Deep domain knowledge in risk, P&L, trading platforms, and financial data
• Technical leadership: mentoring, hiring, code ownership, and cross-team delivery

I'm open to senior and staff engineering roles in fintech, data platforms, and applied AI, where reliability and real business impact matter. Happy to connect.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Applied AI – Loan Data Ingestion (2025–Present)
• Co-led productionization of an agentic AI pipeline for private-credit loan data from SEC filings (~150 filers, ~15K loans/quarter). Early results cut time-to-market from 25+ days to just over 4 and made 40 manual filers addressable.
• Designed and built the agentic extraction workflow (orchestrator with specialized sub-agents, deterministic Python for preprocessing, chunking, and normalization) and its asynchronous, Kafka-based integration with my team's ingestion pipeline; coordinated AI platform, data, and engineering teams, and drove run-monitoring and sub-agent-logging improvements through production feedback.
• Pushed for running the agentic path in parallel with the legacy pipeline kept intact; generated the reconciliation report for human review, and co-led ground-truth validation (99.4% entity-match, 98.0% field accuracy).

Batch Calculation Platform (2023–2025)
• Primary developer of a Python/Celery data acquisition gateway handling more than 120B datapoints daily.
• Designed and rolled out multi-tenancy, growing from 1 to 6 client tenants, and led onboarding end to end.
• Optimized database usage 30x, with nearly a year of no database incidents; built split-and-retry, pause/resume and fair prefetching.

Developer Experience (2021–2022)
• Founding member (1 of 4) of the platform's developer-experience team; owned and modernized an 8+ year-old Python test framework (Docker, Jenkins nightly regression, defect dashboard).
